why_ai: A risk-bearing balance sheet, broker and cedent relationships and adversarial, high-stakes judgement on rare events protect the core, while model runs, data preparation and accounting are exposed.
why_clarity: Treaties recur at fixed renewals under written terms, but whether a cat or casualty price was right is known only when a rare event strikes or claims develop years later.
why_digital: Submissions, models and contracts are worked entirely on screens and traded through brokers across borders, though the market still meets in person around the renewals.

why_ai: The lead underwriter's adjustment of vendor models to each cedent is novel, high-stakes judgement sold through broker relationships; model runs around it automate.
why_clarity: Hundreds of programmes recur at each renewal under shared models, but a load is graded only when a large event hits that cedent.
why_digital: Exposure files in, model runs and quotes out, placed remotely through brokers.

why_ai: Trend selection on long-tail lines under social inflation is consequential judgement that committees own; data assembly is automatable.
why_clarity: Pricing methods are codified, but whether a casualty treaty was priced right is known five to ten years later.
why_digital: Triangles, listings and bordereaux in, prices and reserves out, all on screens.

why_ai: Selecting severity trend for excess layers is adversarial and slow to grade, though the statistics behind it automate well.
why_clarity: Experience and exposure rating follow written methods each renewal, but selections are graded only as large claims develop over years.
why_digital: Ceded data in, layer prices out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Bordereaux normalisation and drift detection automate; the renewal conversation with the MGA and fronting carrier stays human.
why_clarity: Monthly bordereaux recur in the same shape, and drift is confirmed within a year by the loss ratio.
why_digital: Bordereaux in, monitoring and renewal decisions out, worked remotely.

why_ai: Single-risk decisions on large industrial and casualty accounts are judgement sold through broker relationships; document reading automates.
why_clarity: Each risk differs and underwriters read surveys their own way; losses on single risks are rare and slow to arrive.
why_digital: Engineering surveys of physical sites in, quotes out, placed through brokers by email and calls.

why_ai: Reconciling statements and cash calls against contract terms is rules-based work AI-native operations will absorb; disputed losses remain human.
why_clarity: Every statement has a correct figure under the contract, recurring quarterly by the thousand, and checkable at once.
why_digital: Statements and notices in, reconciled balances and payments out, entirely digital.

why_ai: A small, relationship-driven market pricing books of treaties it cannot see; portfolio roll-ups automate but trust between counterparties does not.
why_clarity: Roll-up methods are standard, but each retro placement is bespoke and graded only by rare large events.
why_digital: Portfolio curves in, retro placements out, traded remotely through brokers.

why_ai: Event exposure mapping and collateral tracking automate; allocators' trust in managers is the protected part.
why_clarity: Event losses and collateral releases are defined and eventually known exactly, though early estimates resolve over months.
why_digital: Holdings and reports in, estimates and forecasts out, delivered online to institutions anywhere.

why_ai: Mapping, recoding and plausibility checks on exposure files are the kind of data work AI performs directly.
why_clarity: A model-ready file is well defined, the task recurs on every submission, and errors show at import or in sensitivity runs.
why_digital: Spreadsheets in, model-ready files out, often done offshore.

why_ai: Clause comparison is document work language models handle well; judging materiality and negotiating it stays with specialists.
why_clarity: Every wording can be compared clause by clause with the expiring contract, but whether a change mattered shows only after a loss.
why_digital: Wordings in, deviation reports out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: Contracts need a neutral, trusted publisher of the market loss, which software cannot replace; the aggregation itself automates.
why_clarity: Each event gets a defined market estimate on a published timetable, graded by its own final figure within a year or two.
why_digital: Insurer-reported data in, published estimates out, licensed globally.

why_ai: Hazard science for weakly modelled perils is novel work, but output scales with compute and could be rebuilt by AI-native modellers.
why_clarity: Model building follows scientific methods, but losses validate the models only over rare events.
why_digital: Hazard data in, licensed models out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Bonds need a named, independent modelling agent whose analysis investors rely on; the model runs automate.
why_clarity: Each offering circular analysis follows the same structure per deal, but the bond's risk is graded only if an event triggers it.
why_digital: Sponsor exposure in, published risk analyses out, delivered digitally.

why_ai: Independent validation that supervisors and rating agencies accept needs accountable experts; testing routines automate.
why_clarity: Validation frameworks are documented, but whether an adjusted view is right shows only after rare events.
why_digital: Client models and portfolios in, validation reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Internal cat pricing is quantitative work increasingly done by models; the adjustment judgement and capital accountability keep people in it.
why_clarity: Pricing recurs across hundreds of programmes, but rare events grade it slowly.
why_digital: Exposure in, prices and portfolio analytics out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: Experts testify and sign reports in adversarial proceedings, and parties hire specific people; document review automates.
why_clarity: Each dispute is bespoke and judged by a panel, with outcomes known only at award or settlement.
why_digital: Claims files in, expert reports out, with hearings and audits partly in person.

why_ai: Trend selection is judgement under social inflation, but the modelling behind it is what statistical learning does.
why_clarity: Actuarial methods are codified, but selections are graded only as liability claims develop over years.
why_digital: Ceded data in, assumptions and prices out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: Bespoke, irreversible bids on reserve blocks whose outcome emerges over a decade, negotiated with sellers' advisers.
why_clarity: Valuation methods are standard, but each block is unique and its outcome known years later.
why_digital: Data rooms in, bids and run-off plans out, with deals negotiated through advisers.

why_ai: Investors back specific managers making adversarial, high-stakes allocation decisions; AI becomes their tool.
why_clarity: Returns are measured monthly, but skill separates from catastrophe luck slowly.
why_digital: Deal documents and models in, portfolios out; capital raised through investor relationships.

why_ai: Statutory authority and public accountability for solvency decisions cannot pass to software.
why_clarity: Supervisory frameworks are codified, but whether a reinsurer was adequately capitalised is proved only by stress events.
why_digital: Statutory returns in, reviews and decisions out, with on-site supervision and meetings.

why_ai: Published research is valued for the institution's name; compiling loss tallies and outlooks is largely automatable.
why_clarity: Reports recur on calendars, but their value as thought leadership has no agreed measure.
why_digital: Data in, reports out, published online.

why_ai: Deal directories and market tallies compiled from documents are work AI performs directly.
why_clarity: Deal records and index levels are defined and checkable against offering documents.
why_digital: Documents in, data and news out, entirely online.

why_ai: Submission packaging and placement workflow are software that AI-native competitors can rebuild.
why_clarity: Each submission and placement follows the same steps, recurring every renewal.
why_digital: Data in, workflows and data rooms out, fully online.

why_ai: Fiduciary accountability keeps a regulated bank in the role; the administration itself is automatable.
why_clarity: Collateral balances are exact and reconciled routinely against required amounts.
why_digital: Balances and instructions in, statements out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Advocacy rests on relationships with regulators and legislators; studies are a small, automatable part.
why_clarity: Policy outcomes are political and slow, and studies recur only every few years.
why_digital: Studies and papers published online; advocacy runs through meetings and hearings.
